current_baseline.name: existing_baseline

family.architecture: decoder-only causal transformer (RMSNorm + RoPE + GQA + SwiGLU)
family.positional: RoPE (half-dim interleaved), no learned positional embeddings

notes: Tied embeddings: lm_head reuses tok_emb; only one vocab x d matrix is counted/stored.
GQA: 8 query heads, 4 KV heads, head_dim 48.

scenarios.name: candidate_A_100M
scenarios.headroom_note: ~111M (12-layer trim of a 128M 14-layer variant); closest honest match to the 100M target without arbitrary shrinking
architecture_changes_required: none — same module family (RMSNorm + RoPE + GQA + SwiGLU, tied embeddings)
tokenizer unchanged (vocab 5,822; same specials; no embedding resize)

checkpoint_compatibility.reason: different d_model/n_layers; all Linear/Embedding weights change shape; tokenizer reusable (vocabulary is unchanged)
checkpoint_compatibility.partial_init_possible: tied embedding rows could be re-used only if d_model matched; it does not

risks: RoPE extrapolation beyond 2048 context is unvalidated (affects B and C)
same recipe family; gains come from data and compute, not architecture

feasibility_verdict.reason: The architecture family (RMSNorm + RoPE + GQA + SwiGLU, tied embeddings) scales to 100M/300M/1B by changing width/depth/ffn only. No module family change is required. Existing checkpoints cannot warmstart the scaled models (all weights change shape) but the tokenizer is fully reusable.
architecture_risk_items: RoPE beyond 2048 context unvalidated — validated only to 2048
GQA ratio 2:1 retained at all three scales; nothing else changes
vocab 5,822 is small; output projection stays tied and cheap
